headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for NoLongerEvil Nest thermostats. Supports both the hosted service and self-hosted installations, including mixed configurations.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your NoLongerEvil API key. For multiple servers or self-hosted setups, use the Servers section below instead.

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Only set this if using a self-hosted NoLongerEvil server. Leave empty to use the hosted service (nolongerevil.com).

name.title: Server Name
name.description: Optional label for this server (used in logs).

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Leave empty to use the hosted service (nolongerevil.com). Set to your server's Control API URL for self-hosted.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll thermostats for status updates. Minimum 15 seconds due to API rate limits.

layout.title: Simple Setup (Single API Source)
layout.description: Use these fields if you only have one API source. For multiple servers, use the section below instead.

layout.title: Multiple Servers
layout.description: Configure multiple API sources (hosted + self-hosted). When servers are configured here, the simple setup fields above are ignored.
